title: Only wrap the `autoHide` decorator when needed
body:
Our current pattern in widgets that expose the `hideWhenNoResults` attribute is to wrap the React component inside an `autoHide` decorator, even if set to `false`. We then need to pass two new elements in the props: `hasResults` and `hideWhenNoResults`.

I think this could be simplified by only wrapping with `autoHide` when the `hideWhenNoResults` attribute is set to `true` in the widget. We'll then only have to pass `hasResults` to the component. One less props to pass all the way down, will make things easier.

I already tested that in a (now deleted) branch, this works well
